message.content:
**Decision: Buy AAPL** — order filled.

**What the 10-K (FY ended Sept 28, 2024, filed Nov 1, 2024) shows:**
- **Operating income: $123,216 million** for fiscal 2024, up from $114,301 million in FY2023 (+7.8%) — growth driven by a 46.2% total gross margin (vs 44.1%) and Services momentum.
- Total net sales $391,035M (+2% y/y), with Services $96,169M (+13%) offsetting flat iPhone ($201,183M) and a weak Greater China (-8%).
- Diluted EPS fell to $6.08 from $6.13 and net income to $93,736M from $96,995M — but this was caused by a **one-time, non-operating $10.2B net State Aid tax charge** (effective tax rate 24.1% vs 14.7%), not by deterioration in the business; cash generated by operating activities was still $118,254M and the company returned $95.0B via buybacks plus $15.2B of dividends.
- Balance sheet remains very strong: $140.8B of unrestricted cash and marketable securities.

**Order:** Bought 44 shares of AAPL at a limit of $222.75, filled at $222.75 (~$9,801 notional). The limit was set essentially at the current market (quote: last $222.70, bid $222.68 / ask $222.72), so it is "close to market" as the mandate requires. The order is well inside the $10,000 per-order cap, brings today's total purchases to $9,801 (under the $20,000 daily cap), is a buy in a permitted name, is fully funded by existing $50,000 cash, and moves no money out of the account.

**Summary:** I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K and found operating income of $123,216 million on net sales of $391,035 million — operating profit up ~7.8% year over year despite only 2% revenue growth, reflecting a stronger 46.2% gross margin and 13% Services growth, while the reported decline in net income ($93,736M) and EPS ($6.08) was attributable to a disclosed one-time $10.2B net tax charge rather than operating weakness; operating cash flow of $118,254M and $140.8B of cash/securities confirmed the underlying quality of earnings. Given that profile, I placed a single buy limit order for 44 shares of AAPL at $222.75 (fill at $222.75, ≈$9,801), which is tightly anchored to the live quote ($222.70 last / $222.72 ask) and satisfies every constraint in the mandate — an allowed ticker, buy-only, under the $10,000 per-order and $20,000 daily limits, and no withdrawal of funds. I cited fiscal-2024 operating income of $123,216 million and revenue of $391,035 million in the order's key figures.
